why.summary: Travelers cannot read foreign menus and order badly

ratings.rationale: The user says ordering abroad is stressful and they once got a dish they could not eat. No frequency, cost or consequence beyond one anecdote.
The user has not said what they or others do today. Google Lens translate is an obvious alternative they did not mention.
"Maybe freemium" with no price logic and no cost side.
No measurable outcome named.

openQuestions: What do you and other travelers do today when you cannot read a menu, and where does that fail?
How often does the problem bite on a typical trip?

ratings.rationale: "Travelers" is the whole audience. No role, context or workflow.
Implied trigger is arriving abroad. No objections considered.
No channel named and no sign the builder can reach travelers.
Buyer and user not discussed. No excluded segment.

openQuestions: Which traveler feels this most sharply, and do you know any of them?

what.summary: Photo of a menu to explained dishes, plus six more features

ratings.rationale: Photo in, dish explanations out is a clear loop. Value moment is not pinned down.
Seven features listed: translate, allergens, recommendations, favorites, sharing, offline, restaurant reviews. No acceptance criteria.
Nothing is excluded.
A photo is implied. Language, dietary profile and account are not discussed.

caps.reason: Seven features and no anti-scope list

openQuestions: Which of the seven features can wait until after the first trip?

ratings.rationale: "An app" means native mobile to the user. No alternatives considered.
Fit to the traveler's moment (standing in a restaurant, phone in hand) is plausible but unexamined.
Roaming data, weak connectivity and camera quality matter for travel and were not raised.
A vision model API is implied. Nothing else named.

caps.reason: Native app chosen with no hardware or habit reason over the web

openQuestions: Why native rather than a web page the traveler opens from the camera?

whether.summary: Paid vision model with no cost estimate; allergen advice liability unexamined

ratings.rationale: Every scan calls a paid vision model. No cost per scan or per user estimated.
Latency per scan and handwritten menus are obvious risks, not yet discussed.
Allergen information carries real liability. Photo retention not discussed.
No edge cases named.

caps.reason: Paid model calls with no cost per active user

openQuestions: What does one scan cost at the vision model's current pricing, and how many scans does a trip take?

when.summary: Wants it before a trip in six weeks; capacity unknown

ratings.rationale: Solo builder, hours per week not stated.
No intermediate milestone.
Six weeks until the trip. No buffer, no definition of done.
Nothing named to drop when behind.

caps.reason: Seven features on a native app in six weeks of unknown capacity

openQuestions: How many hours a week do you have between now and the trip?
